## About
Fixed Right Automotive started with one goal: to give the community a dependable, fair and honest full-service garage. That is still how we work on Old Frankstown Rd in Monroeville.
We look after cars and light and medium duty trucks, plus ATV and UTV service, recreational vehicles and trailers. Business owners can also talk with us about keeping a fleet on schedule.
Neighbors have given us a 4.6 rating across 58 Google reviews. One customer put it simply: if you want zero stress with your car, these are your guys.

## Services
- Complete auto repair and maintenance: Repair and maintenance for cars and light and medium duty trucks, including engine and transmission work, diagnostics, and repair and replacement.
- State inspection and emissions: State inspection and emissions for cars and trucks.
- Oil change and lube: Routine oil changes and lube services.
- Air conditioning service: Service for your vehicle's air conditioning.
- Tire sales and service: Tire sales and service for cars and trucks.
- ATV and UTV service: Full-service maintenance, repairs and tires.
- Trailer inspection and service: Safety checks and full service and maintenance for trailers. One reviewer brings their trailer to us every year for inspection.
- Fleet service: Routine scheduled maintenance, full-service maintenance and repairs for business fleets. Call to talk through options.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We are open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: How do I schedule an appointment or ask about fleet service?
A: Give us a call at (412) 798-5420 and we can set up a time or go over fleet service options.

Q: Do you inspect trailers?
A: Yes. We do safety checks and service for trailers. One reviewer brings their trailer to us every year for inspection.

The damage was extensive but they finished it in about a week.  I was beyond impressed.
